firstMessage:
`Sessions.login` is linked to `R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT`, which controls the `RISK-ACCOUNT-TAKEOVER` threat. The repo’s `AGENTS.md` requires me to ask before changing code with that link.

May I move the password hash computation ahead of the lock check, while keeping locked accounts rejected and running the account tests afterward?
finalMessage:
Updated [Sessions.login](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.intent.ts-shop.T14.3/repo/src/accounts.ts:93) to compute the password hash before checking the lock. Locked accounts still refuse the login, but now perform the hash work first.

The change keeps `R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT` true and adds `R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT-TIMING` as a draft item. Both are linked to the changed code; they need review because they control, or refine an item that controls, `RISK-ACCOUNT-TAKEOVER`. The linked tests, “locks the account after five failures” and “hashes the password before refusing a locked account,” pass. The full suite passes: **37/37**.
